VBO:0200841.summary: Close loyalty can mark life with a Mackenzie River Husky: Ragnar was a much-loved adult companion whose owner prized that bond. Northern village freight dogs were developed for small teams hauling heavy loads through deep snow and wooded or hilly terrain. Different communities named and maintained their own dogs, and the broad label has covered varied populations.
VBO:0200841.shortDescription: Mackenzie River Huskies have a varied freight-dog history; named companion Ragnar’s own story highlights a close, loyal bond.
